title: Desertec Industrial Initiative's 2014 Collapse
summary: A $55 billion plan to power Europe via North African solar plants, launched in 2009 by a consortium of German firms, was abandoned in 2014 after political and financial disputes left the project without investors or host-country agreements.

facts.label: Founded
facts.value: 2009, as Dii GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany

facts.label: Founding consortium
facts.value: 12 European companies including Siemens, E.ON, RWE, Deutsche Bank, and Munich Re

facts.label: Target
facts.value: Supply 15% of Europe's electricity from Saharan solar and wind by 2050

facts.label: Key withdrawals
facts.value: Siemens (2012), Bosch (2013), then E.ON and others by 2014; 12 of 20 members left

facts.label: Dissolved
facts.value: October 2014; Dii GmbH wound down, replaced by a smaller advisory body
